name: AccountInspection
summary: Enables the Account Intelligence view. The Account Intelligence view is a consolidated dashboard showing account metrics, activities, and related opportunities and cases.

name: AccountingSubledgerGrowthEdition
summary: Provides three permission sets that enable access to Accounting Subledger Growth features.
description: Requires that you also include the DataProcessingEngine scratch org feature in your scratch org definition file. Requires that you enable Data Pipelines. Requires configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org. See Accounting Subledger in Salesforce Help.

name: AccountingSubledgerStarterEdition
summary: Provides three permission sets that enable access to Accounting Subledger Starter features.
description: Requires that you also include the DataProcessingEngine scratch org feature in your scratch org definition file. Requires that you enable Data Pipelines. Requires configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org. See Accounting Subledger in Salesforce Help.

name: AccountingSubledgerUser
summary: Enables organization-wide access to Accounting Subledger Growth features when the package is installed.
description: Requires that you install the Accounting Subledger or Accounting Subledger for Industries managed package. If you install the Accounting Subledger package, also set up the Opportunity object. See Accounting Subledger Legacy Documentation in Salesforce Help.

name: AddCustomApps:<value>
summary: Increases the maximum number of custom apps allowed in an org. Indicate a value from 1–30.
description: 1–30, Multiplier: 1

name: AddCustomObjects:<value>
summary: Increases the maximum number of custom objects allowed in the org. Indicate a value from 1–30.
description: 1–30, Multiplier: 1

name: AddCustomRelationships:<value>
summary: Increases the maximum number of custom relationships allowed on an object. Indicate a value from 1–10.
description: 1–10, Multiplier: 5

name: AddCustomTabs:<value>
summary: Increases the maximum number of custom tabs allowed in an org. Indicate a value from 1–30.
description: 1–30, Multiplier: 1

name: AddDataComCRMRecordCredit:<value>
summary: Increases record import credits assigned to a user in your scratch org. Indicate a value from 1–30.
description: 1–30, Multiplier: 1

name: AddInsightsQueryLimit:<value>
summary: Increases the size of your CRM Analytics query results. Indicate a value from 1–30 (multiplier is 10). Setting the quantity to 6 increases the query results to 60.
description: 1–30, Multiplier: 10

name: AdditionalFieldHistory:<value>
summary: Increases the number of fields you can track history for beyond the default, which is 20 fields. Indicate a value between 1–40.
description: 1–40, Multiplier: 1Previous name: AddHistoryFieldsPerEntity.

name: AdmissionsConnectUser
summary: Enables the Admissions Connect components. Without this scratch org feature parameter, the custom Admissions Connect components render as blank.
description: Next, install the Admissions Connect package in the scratch org. For installation instructions, see Install Admissions Connect in Salesforce Help.

name: AdvisorLinkFeature
summary: Enables the Student Success Hub components. Without this scratch org feature parameter, the custom Student Success Hub components render as blank.
description: Next, install the Student Success Hub package in the scratch org. For setup instructions, see Install Student Success Hub in Salesforce Help.

name: AdvisorLinkPathwaysFeature
summary: Enables the Pathways components. Without this scratch org feature parameter, the custom Pathways components render as blank.
description: Next, install the Pathways package in the scratch org. For setup instructions, see Set Up Pathways in Salesforce Help.

name: AIAttribution
summary: Provides access to Einstein Attribution for Marketing Cloud Account Engagement. Einstein Attribution uses AI modeling to dynamically assign attribution percentages to multiple campaign touchpoints.
description: Before enabling Einstein Attribution, make sure that enableAIAttribution and enableCampaignInfluence2 are set to true.This feature is available in Account Engagement Advanced and Premium editions.Optional configuration steps are accessible in Setup in the scratch org. For more information, see Salesforce Help: Einstein Attribution.

name: AllUserIdServiceAccess
summary: Enables all users to access all users’ information via the user ID service.
description: The AllUserIdServiceAccess permission is off by default for all new and existing orgs. To turn on this feature, contact Salesforce Customer Support.

name: AnalyticsAdminPerms
summary: Enables all permissions required to administer the CRM Analytics platform, including permissions to enable creating CRM Analytics templated apps and CRM Analytics Apps.
description: See Set Up the CRM Analytics Platform in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: AnalyticsAppEmbedded
summary: Provides one CRM Analytics Embedded App license for the CRM Analytics platform.

name: ApexGuruCodeAnalyzer
summary: Enables ApexGuru's generative AI-powered runtime insights in Salesforce Code Analyzer, which delivers Apex code quality recommendations directly in developer IDEs.
description: To improve developer accuracy and speed, use ApexGuru in Salesforce Code Analyzer to detect antipatterns using both static analysis and generative AI.For more information about ApexGuru, see ApexGuru Insights in Salesforce Help.

name: API
summary: Even in the editions (Professional, Group) that don’t provide API access, REST API is enabled by default. Use this scratch org feature to access additional APIs (SOAP, Streaming, Bulk, Bulk 2.0).
description: See Salesforce editions with API access for more information.

name: ArcGraphCommunity
summary: Lets you add Actionable Relationship Center (ARC) components to Experience Cloud pages so your users can view ARC Relationship Graphs.
description: Provides 1 seat of the FinancialServicesEALoginAddon add-on license.Requires that you install Financial Services Cloud. See Customize Experience Cloud Templates using ARC Components in Financial Services Cloud Administrator Guide.

name: Assessments
summary: Enables dynamic Assessments features, which enables both Assessment Questions and Assessment Question Sets.
description: Add these options to your scratch org feature definition file. For "edition," you can indicate any of the supported scratch org feature editions.Add the Assessment to the page layout. See Page Layouts in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: AssetScheduling:<value>
summary: Enables Asset Scheduling license. Asset Scheduling makes it easier to book rooms and equipments. Indicate a value between 1–10.
description: 1–10See Enable Asset Scheduling in Salesforce Scheduler in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: AssociationEngine
summary: Enables the Association Engine, which automatically associates new accounts with the user’s current branch by creating branch unit customer records.
description: Provides 11 seats of the FSCComprehensivePsl user license and 11 seats of the FSCComprehensiveAddOn add-on license.Requires that you install Financial Services Cloud. See AssociationEngineSettings in Metadata API Developer Guide.

name: AuthorApex
summary: Enables you to access and modify Apex code in a scratch org. Enabled by default in Enterprise and Developer Editions.
description: For Group and Professional Edition orgs, this feature is disabled by default. Enabling the AuthorApex feature lets you edit and test your Apex classes.

name: B2BCommerce
summary: Provides the B2B License. B2BCommerce enables business-to-business (B2B) commerce in your org. Create and update B2B stores. Create and manage buyer accounts. Sell products to other businesses.
description: Requires that you also include the Communities scratch org feature in your scratch org definition file to create a store using B2B Commerce. Not available in Professional, Partner Professional, Group, or Partner Group Edition orgs.

name: B2BLoyaltyManagement
summary: Enables the B2B Loyalty Management license. Create loyalty programs and set up loyalty program-specific processes that allow you to recognize, rewards, and retain customers.
description: See Loyalty Management in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: B2CCommerceGMV
summary: Provides the B2B2C Commerce License. B2B2C Commerce allows you to quickly stand up an ecommerce site to promote brands and sell products into multiple digital channels. You can create and update retail storefronts in your org, and create and manage person accounts.
description: Also requires the Communities feature in your scratch org definition file.Not available in Professional, Partner Professional, Group, or Partner Group Edition orgs.For more information, see Salesforce Help at Salesforce B2B Commerce and B2B2C Commerce..

name: B2CLoyaltyManagement
summary: Enables the Loyalty Management - Growth license. Create loyalty programs and set up loyalty program-specific processes that allow you to recognize, rewards, and retain customers.
description: See Loyalty Management in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: B2CLoyaltyManagementPlus
summary: Enables the Loyalty Management - Advanced license. Create loyalty programs and set up loyalty program-specific processes that allow you to recognize, rewards, and retain customers.
description: See Loyalty Management in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: BatchManagement
summary: Enables the Batch Management license. Batch Management allows you to process a high volume of records in manageable batches.
description: See Batch Management in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: BenefitManagement
summary: Enables the objects, features, and permissions for managing benefits programs, benefit disbursements, and benefit applicant tracking in Public Sector Solutions.
description: To enable BenefitManagement, add these features and settings to your scratch org definition file.

name: BigObjectsBulkAPI
summary: Enables the scratch org to use BigObjects in the Bulk API.
description: See Big Objects Implementation Guide for more information.

name: BillingAdvanced
summary: Enables access to all the Billing features and objects that are available with the Revenue Cloud Billing license in the scratch org.
description: To enable BillingAdvanced, add these settings to your scratch org definition file.

name: Briefcase
summary: Enables the use of Briefcase Builder in a scratch org, which allows you to create offline briefcases that make selected records available for viewing offline.

name: BudgetManagement
summary: Gives users access to budget management features and objects. To enable budget management, add this feature to your scratch org definition file.
description: See Budget Management in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: BusinessRulesEngine
summary: Enables Business Rules Engine, which enables both expression sets and lookup tables.
description: Provides 10 Business Rules Engine Designer and 10 Business Rules Engine Runtime licenses. For more information, see Business Rules Engine in Salesforce Help.

name: BYOCCaaS
summary: Enables you to set up and test a partner contact center that integrates with supported Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) providers in your scratch org.
description: This feature requires that you also include the ServiceCloud and Scrt2Conversation scratch org features in your scratch org definition file. You must also enable second-generation managed packaging to use this feature in a scratch org. Available in Salesforce Enterprise and Developer Editions.For setup and configuration steps, see Bring Your Own Channel for CCaaS in Salesforce Help.

name: BYOOTT
summary: Enables you to set up and test a Bring Your Own Channel for Messaging channel that integrates with supported Messaging providers in your scratch org.
description: This feature requires that you also include the ServiceCloud and Scrt2Conversation scratch org features in your scratch org definition file. You must also enable second-generation managed packaging to use this feature in a scratch org. Available in Salesforce Enterprise and Developer Editions.For setup and configuration steps, see Bring Your Own Channel in Salesforce Help.

name: CacheOnlyKeys
summary: Enables the cache-only keys service. This feature allows you to store your key material outside of Salesforce, and have the Cache-Only Key Service fetch your key on demand from a key service that you control.
description: Requires enabling PlatformEncryption and configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org. See Which User Permissions Does Shield Platform Encryption Require?, Generate a Tenant Secret with Salesforce, and Cache-Only Key Service in Salesforce Help.

name: CalloutSizeMB:<value>
summary: Increases the maximum size of an Apex callout. Indicate a value between 3–12.
description: 3–12, Multiplier: 1

name: CampaignInfluence2
summary: Provides access to Customizable Campaign Influence for Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud Account Engagement. Customizable Campaign Influence can auto-associate or allow manual creation of relationships among campaigns and opportunities to track attribution.
description: To enable Customizable Campaign Influence, set enableCampaignInfluence2 to true.This feature is available in Salesforce Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and Developer Editions.Optional configuration steps are accessible in Setup in the scratch org. For more information, see Salesforce Help: Customizable Campaign Influence.

name: CascadeDelete
summary: Provides lookup relationships with the same cascading delete functionality previously only available to master-detail relationships. To prevent records from being accidentally deleted, cascade-delete is disabled by default.

name: CaseClassification
summary: Enables Einstein Case Classification. Case Classification offers recommendations to your agents so they can select the best value. You can also automatically save the best recommendation and route the case to the right agent.

name: CaseWrapUp
summary: Enables Einstein Case Wrap-Up. To help agents complete cases quickly, Einstein Case Wrap-Up recommends case field values based on past chat transcripts.
description: Available in Enterprise Edition scratch orgs. Requires configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org.See Set Up Einstein Classification Apps in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: CGAnalytics
summary: Enables the Consumer Goods Analytics org perm in scratch orgs.
description: Provides 1 seat of the CGAnalyticsPlus add-on license.

name: ChangeDataCapture
summary: Enables Change Data Capture, if the scratch org edition doesn't automatically enable it.

name: Chatbot
summary: Enables deployment of Bot metadata into a scratch org, and allows you to create and edit bots.
description: To use this feature, turn on Enable Einstein Features in the Dev Hub org to accept the Terms of Service. See Einstein Bots in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: ChatterEmailFooterLogo
summary: ChatterEmailFooterLogo allows you to use the Document ID of a logo image, which you can use to customize chatter emails.
description: See Add Your Custom Brand to Email Notifications in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: ChatterEmailFooterText
summary: ChatterEmailFooterText allows you to use footer text in customized Chatter emails.
description: See Add Your Custom Brand to Email Notifications in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: ChatterEmailSenderName
summary: ChatterEmailSenderName allows you to customize the name that appears as the sender’s name in the email notification. For example, your company’s name.
description: See Chatter Email Settings and Branding in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: CloneApplication
summary: CloneApplication allows you to clone an existing custom Lightning app and make required customizations to the new app. This way, you don’t have to start from scratch, especially when you want to create apps with simple variations.
description: See Create Lightning Apps in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: CMSMaxContType
summary: Limits the number of distinct content types you can create within Salesforce CMS to 21.

name: CMSMaxNodesPerContType
summary: Limits the maximum number of child nodes (fields) you can create for a particular content type to 15.

name: CMSUnlimitedUse
summary: Enables unlimited content records, content types, and bandwidth usage in Salesforce CMS.

name: Communities
summary: Allows the org to create an Experience Cloud site. Experience Cloud uses the term Communities in its configuration. To use Communities, you must also include communitiesSettings > enableNetworksEnabled in the settings section of your scratch org definition file.
description: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

name: CompareReportsOrgPerm
summary: Enables the org permission to allow for comparison of Lightning Reports.

name: ConAppPluginExecuteAsUser
summary: Enables the pluginExecutionUser field in the ConnectedApp Metadata API object.

name: ConcStreamingClients:<value>
summary: Increases the maximum number of concurrent clients (subscribers) across all channels and for all event types for API version 36.0 and earlier. Indicate a value between 20–4,000.
description: 20–4,000, Multiplier: 1

name: ConnectedAppCustomNotifSubscription
summary: Enables connected apps to subscribe to custom notification types, which are used to send custom desktop and mobile notifications.
description: Sending custom notifications requires both CustomNotificationType to create notification types and ConnectedAppCustomNotifSubscription to subscribe to notification types. See Manage Your Notifications with Notification Builder in Salesforce Help for more information on custom notifications.

name: ConnectedAppToolingAPI
summary: Enables the use of connected apps with the Tooling API.

name: ConsentEventStream
summary: Enables the Consent Event Stream permission for the org.
description: See Use the Consent Event Stream in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: ConsolePersistenceInterval:<value>
summary: Increases how often console data is saved, in minutes. Indicate a value between 0–500. To disable auto save, set the value to 0.
description: 0–500, Multiplier: 1

name: ContactsToMultipleAccounts
summary: Enables the contacts to multiple accounts feature. This feature lets you relate a contact to two or more accounts.

name: ContractApprovals
summary: Enables contract approvals, which allow you to track contracts through an approval process.

name: ContractManagement
summary: Enables the Contract Lifecycle (CLM) Management features in the org.

name: ContractMgmtInd
summary: Enables the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) features for Industries.

name: CoreCpq
summary: Enables read-write access to Revenue Cloud features and objects. To use Revenue Cloud, you must also include revenueManagementSettings > enableCoreCPQ in the settings section of your scratch org definition file.
description: Add these options to your scratch org definition file.

name: CPQ
summary: Enables the licensed features required to install the Salesforce CPQ managed package but doesn't install the package automatically.
description: For additional information and configuration steps, see Manage Your Quotes with CPQ in Salesforce Help.

name: CustomerDataPlatform
summary: Enables the CustomerDataPlatform license in scratch orgs.
description: To create scratch orgs that use Data Cloud, you must first log a case with Salesforce Partner Support. This feature can be enabled on your Partner Business Org (PBO) only. After it’s enabled, you can create scratch orgs with Data Cloud features. . See Salesforce Help: Feature Availability in Data Cloud and Customer Data Platform for a list of functionality available with the CustomerDataPlatform license.

name: CustomerDataPlatformLite
summary: Enables the Data Cloud license in scratch orgs. You must also include the CustomerDataPlatform feature and enableCustomerDataPlatform Metadata API setting in your scratch org definition.
description: To create scratch orgs that use Data Cloud, you must first log a case with Salesforce Partner Support. This feature can be enabled on your Partner Business Org (PBO) only. After it’s enabled, you can create scratch orgs with Data Cloud features. See Salesforce Help: Feature Availability in Data Cloud and Customer Data Platform for a list of functionality available with the Data Cloud license.

name: CustomerExperienceAnalytics
summary: Enables the Customer Lifecycle Analytics org perm in scratch orgs.
description: Provides 1 seat of the CustomerExperienceAnalyticsPlus add-on license.

name: CustomFieldDataTranslation
summary: Enables translation of custom field data for Work Type Group, Service Territory, and Service Resource objects. You can enable data translation for custom fields with Text, Text Area, Text Area (Long), Text Area (Rich), and URL types.
description: Requires that you also include the EntityTranslation scratch org feature in your scratch org definition file. Not available in Professional, Partner Professional, Group, or Partner Group Edition orgs.

name: CustomNotificationType
summary: Allows the org to create custom notification types, which are used to send custom desktop and mobile notifications.
description: Sending custom notifications requires both CustomNotificationType to create notification types and ConnectedAppCustomNotifSubscription to subscribe to notification types. See Manage Your Notifications with Notification Builder in Salesforce Help for more information on custom notifications.

name: DataComDnbAccounts
summary: Provides a license to Data.com account features.

name: DataComFullClean
summary: Provides a license to Data.com cleaning features, and allows users to turn on auto fill clean settings for jobs.

name: DataMaskUser
summary: Provides 30 Data Mask permission set licenses. This permission set enables access to an installed Salesforce Data Mask package.
description: For additional installation and configuration steps, see Install the Managed Package in Salesforce Help.

name: DataProcessingEngine
summary: Enables the Data Processing Engine license. Data Processing Engine helps transform data that's available in your Salesforce org and write back the transformation results as new or updated records.
description: See Data Processing Engine in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: DebugApex
summary: Enables Apex Interactive Debugger. You can use it to debug Apex code by setting breakpoints and checkpoints, and inspecting your code to find bugs.

name: DecisionTable
summary: Enables Decision Table license. Decision tables read business rules and decide the outcome for records in your Salesforce org or for the values that you specify.
description: See Decision Table in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: DefaultWorkflowUser
summary: Sets the scratch org admin as the default workflow user.

name: DeferSharingCalc
summary: Allows admins to suspend group membership and sharing rule calculations and to resume them later.
description: Requires configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org. See Defer Sharing Calculations in Salesforce Help.

name: DevelopmentWave
summary: Enables CRM Analytics development in a scratch org. It assigns five platform licenses and five CRM Analytics platform licenses to the org, along with assigning the permission set license to the admin user. It also enables the CRM Analytics Templates and Einstein Discovery features.

name: DeviceTrackingEnabled
summary: Enables Device Tracking.

name: DevOpsCenter
summary: Enables DevOps Center in scratch orgs so that partners can create second-generation managed packages that extend or enhance the functionality in the DevOps Center application (base) package.
description: Ask a Salesforce admin to enable DevOps Center in the Dev Hub org. From Setup, enter DevOps Center in the Quick Find box, then select DevOps Center. You can create scratch orgs after the org preference is enabled.Add these options to your scratch org definition file:If you create a scratch org based on an org shape with DevOps Center enabled, we still require that you add the DevOps Center feature and setting to the scratch org definition for legal reasons as part of the DevOps Center terms and conditions.Salesforce Help: Build an Extension Package for DevOps Center

name: DisableManageIdConfAPI
summary: Limits access to the LoginIP and ClientBrowser API objects to allow view or delete only.

name: DisclosureFramework
summary: Provides the permission set licenses and permission sets required to configure Disclosure and Compliance Hub.
description: Add these options to your scratch org definition file:For configuration steps, see Disclosure and Compliance Hub in the Set Up and Maintain Net Zero Cloud guide in Salesforce Help.

name: Division
summary: Turns on the Manage Divisions feature under Company Settings. Divisions let you segment your organization's data into logical sections, making searches, reports, and list views more meaningful to users. Divisions are useful for organizations with extremely large amounts of data.

name: DocGen
summary: Enables the Document Generation Feature in the Org.

name: DocGenDesigner
summary: Enables the designers to create and configure document templates.

name: DocGenInd
summary: Enables the Industry Document Generation features in the org.

name: DocumentChecklist
summary: Enables Document Tracking and Approval features, and adds the Document Checklist permission set. Document tracking features let you define documents to upload and approve, which supports processes like loan applications or action plans.
description: See Enable Document Tracking and Approvals in the Financial Services Cloud Administrator Guide for more information.

name: DocumentReaderPageLimit
summary: Limits the number of pages sent for data extraction to 5.
description: See Intelligent Form Reader in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: DSARPortability
summary: Enables an org to access the DSARPortability feature in Privacy Center. Also, provides one seat each of the PrivacyCenter and PrivacyCenterAddOn licenses.
description: See Portability in the Salesforce REST API Developer Guide for more information.

name: DurableClassicStreamingAPI
summary: Enables Durable PushTopic Streaming API for API version 37.0 and later.
description: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

name: DurableGenericStreamingAPI
summary: Enables Durable Generic Streaming API for API version 37.0 and later.
description: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

name: DynamicClientCreationLimit
summary: Allows the org to register up to 100 OAuth 2.0 connected apps through the dynamic client registration endpoint.

name: EAndUDigitalSales
summary: Enables the Energy and Utilities Digital Sales feature in the org.

name: EAndUSelfServicePortal
summary: Enables the Self Service Portal features for Digital Experience users in the org.

name: EAOutputConnectors
summary: Enable CRM Analytics Output Connectors.
description: This scratch org requires the Dev Hub to have the EAOutputConnectors permission. See Salesforce Output Connection in Salesforce Help for more details.

name: EASyncOut
summary: Enable CRM Analytics SyncOut.
description: This scratch org requires the Dev Hub to have the EASyncOut permission. See Sync Out for Snowflake in Salesforce Help for more details.

name: EdPredictionM3Threshold
summary: Sets the number of records in the payload to 10, after which the Einstein Discovery prediction service uses M3.

name: EdPredictionTimeout
summary: Sets the maximum duration of a single Einstein Discovery prediction to 100 milliseconds.

name: EdPredictionTimeoutBulk
summary: Sets the maximum duration of a single Einstein Discovery prediction when it runs in bulk to 10 milliseconds.

name: EdPredictionTimeoutByomBulk
summary: Sets the maximum duration of a single Bring Your Own Model (BYOM) Einstein Discovery prediction to 100 milliseconds.

name: EducationCloud: <value>
summary: Enables use of Education Cloud.
description: Maximum: 10; Multiplier: 1Standard set up steps are required after enabling this feature. See Set Up Education Cloud in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: Einstein1AIPlatform
summary: Provides access to Einstein generative AI features such as Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Model Builder, and the Models API. To use generative AI features, you must also include einsteinGptSettings > enableEinsteinGptPlatform in the settings section of your scratch org definition file.
description: Add these options to your scratch org definition file:After you generate the scratch org, Prompt Builder isn’t available until you assign yourself the Manage Prompts permission in the scratch org.When packaging a prompt template in second-generation packages, add the EinsteinGPTPromptTemplateManager permission set to the sfdx-project.json file. See Considerations for Packaging Prompt Templates in Salesforce Help for details.Available in Developer and Enterprise Edition scratch orgs. Requires configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org. Many generative AI features also require a Data Cloud license.See Einstein Generative AI in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: EinsteinAnalyticsPlus
summary: Provides one CRM Analytics Plus license for the CRM Analytics platform.

name: EinsteinArticleRecommendations
summary: Provides licenses for Einstein Article Recommendations. Einstein Article Recommendations uses data from past cases to identify Knowledge articles that are most likely to help your customer service agents address customer inquiries.
description: Available in Enterprise Edition scratch orgs. Requires configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org.See Set Up Einstein Article Recommendations in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: EinsteinBuilderFree
summary: Provides a license that allows admins to create one enabled prediction with Einstein Prediction Builder. Einstein Prediction Builder is custom AI for admins
description: For configuration steps, see Einstein Prediction Builder in Salesforce Help.

name: EinsteinDocReader
summary: Provides the license required to enable and use Intelligent Form Reader in a scratch org. Intelligent Form Reader uses optical character recognition to automatically extract data with Amazon Textract.
description: To use this scratch org feature, the Dev Hub org requires the EinsteinDocReader and SalesforceManagedIFR permissions. For information about Intelligent Form Reader, see Intelligent Form Reader in Salesforce Help.

name: EinsteinRecommendationBuilder
summary: Provides a license to create recommendations with Einstein Recommendation Builder. Einstein Recommendation Builder lets you build custom AI recommendations.
description: Enabled in Developer and Enterprise Editions. Requires configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org. You also need the EinsteinRecommendationBuilderMetadata feature to use Einstein Recommendation Builder in scratch org.

name: EinsteinSalesRepFdbk
summary: Enables the Agentforce Sales Coach feature in an org. This scratch org feature also includes a large number of Einstein for Sales Generative AI features.
description: The EinsteinSalesRepFdbk scratch org feature enables Agentforce for Sales standard actions, such as Create Close Plan, Get Product Pricing, Meeting Follow-Up Email, Send Meeting Request, Identify Contact Role, Identify Key Contacts, Find Similar Opportunities, Review My Day, and Find Contact Interactions. It also enables Einstein Generative AI features, such as Sales Call Summaries, Call Explorer, Generative Conversation Insights, and Automatic Contact Enhancement.

name: EinsteinSearch
summary: Provides the license required to use and enable Einstein Search features in a scratch org.
description: Available in Professional and Enterprise Edition scratch orgs. Requires configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org.

name: EinsteinVisits
summary: Enables Consumer Goods Cloud. With Consumer Goods cloud, transform the way you collaborate with your retail channel partners. Empower your sales managers to plan visits and analyze your business’s health across stores. Also, allow your field reps to track inventory, take orders, and capture visit details using the Retail Execution mobile app.

name: EinsteinVisitsED
summary: Enables Einstein Discovery, which can be used to get store visit recommendations. With Einstein Visits ED, you can create a visit frequency strategy that allows Einstein to provide optimal store visit recommendations.
description: See Create a Visit Frequency Next Best Action Strategy in Salesforce Help.

name: EmbeddedLoginForIE
summary: Provides JavaScript files that support Embedded Login in IE11.

name: EmpPublishRateLimit:<value>
summary: Increases the maximum number of standard-volume platform event notifications published per hour. Indicate a value between 1,000–10,000.
description: 1,000–10,000, Multiplier: 1

name: EnablePRM
summary: Enables the partner relationship management permissions for the org.

name: EnableManageIdConfUI
summary: Enables access to the LoginIP and ClientBrowser API objects to verify a user's identity in the UI.

name: Enablement
summary: Enables features for creating, taking, and tracking sales programs with Enablement. Business operations experts and sales leaders identify the revenue outcomes they want sales reps to achieve, such as increased average deal sizes or shorter ramp times. Then, they create programs that help sales reps work towards those outcomes as part of their daily work.
description: See Sales Programs and Partner Tracks with Enablement in Salesforce Help and see the Sales Programs and Partner Tracks with Enablement Developer Guide for more information.

name: EnableSetPasswordInApi
summary: Enables you to use sf org generate password to change a password without providing the old password.

name: EncryptionStatisticsInterval:<value>
summary: Defines the interval (in seconds) between encryption statistics gathering processes. The maximum value is 604,800 seconds (7 days). The default is once per 86,400 seconds (24 hours).
description: 0–60,4800, Multiplier: 1Requires enabling PlatformEncryption and some configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org. See Which User Permissions Does Shield Platform Encryption Require?, and Generate a Tenant Secret with Salesforce in Salesforce Help.

name: EncryptionSyncInterval:<value>
summary: Defines how frequently (in seconds) the org can synchronize data with the active key material. The default and maximum value is 604,800 seconds (7 days). To synchronize data more frequently, indicate a value, in seconds, equal to or larger than 0.
description: 0–604,800, Multiplier: 1Requires enabling PlatformEncryption and some configuration using the Setup menu in the scratch org. See Which User Permissions Does Shield Platform Encryption Require?, and Generate a Tenant Secret with Salesforce in Salesforce Help.

name: EnergyAndUtilitiesCloud
summary: Enables the Energy and Utilities Cloud features in the org.

name: Entitlements
summary: Enables entitlements. Entitlements are units of customer support in Salesforce, such as phone support or web support that represent terms in service agreements.

name: ERMAnalytics
summary: Enables the ERM Analytics org perm in your scratch org.
description: Provides 1 seat of the ERMAnalyticsPlus add-on license.

name: EventLogFile
summary: Enables API access to your org's event log files. The event log files contain information about your org’s operational events that you can use to analyze usage trends and user behavior.

name: EntityTranslation
summary: Enables translation of field data for Work Type Group, Service Territory, and Service Resource objects.
description: To translate custom field data, also include the CustomFieldDataTranslation scratch org feature in your scratch org definition file. Not available in Professional, Partner Professional, Group, or Partner Group Edition orgs.

name: ExcludeSAMLSessionIndex
summary: Excludes Session Index in SAML sign-on (SSO) and single logout (SLO) flows.
description: The ExcludeSAMLSessionIndex permission is off by default for all new and existing orgs. name: HealthCloudAddOn
summary: Enables use of Health Cloud.
description: See Administer Health Cloud in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: HealthCloudForCmty
summary: Enables use of Health Cloud for Experience Cloud Sites.
description: See Experience Cloud Sites in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: HealthCloudMedicationReconciliation

Sales managers can create custom sales processes that guide reps through handling different types of prospects. And sales reps can rapidly handle prospects with a prioritized list and other productivity-boosting features. The Sales Engagement feature can be deployed in scratch orgs, but the settings for the feature can’t be updated through the scratch org definition file. Instead, configure settings directly in the Sales Engagement app.

name: HighVolumePlatformEventAddOn
summary: Increases the daily delivery allocation of high-volume platform events or change data capture events by 100,000 events. This scratch org feature simulates the purchase of an add-on. If the org has the HighVolumePlatformEventAddOn, the daily allocation is flexible and isn’t enforced strictly to allow for usage peaks.
description: See Platform Event Allocations in the Platform Events Developer Guide.

name: IndustriesActionPlan

description: Previous name: ActionPlan. For more information and configuration steps, see Enable Actions Plans in Salesforce Help.

name: IndustriesBranchManagement

name: IndustriesMfgAdvncdAccFrcs

Tailor your forecasting configurations to your objectives to generate accurate, relevant forecasts.
description: See Create Holistic, Multi-Enterprise Forecasts with Advanced Account Forecasting in Salesforce Help for more information.

Sales managers can use those visits to monitor performance, arrange for periodic check-ins, conduct trainings, upsell and cross-sell products, and follow up on sales agreement renewals and warranty expiration.
description: See Partner Visit Management in Manufacturing Cloud in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: IndustriesMfgProgram
summary: Enables Program Based Business. With Program Based Business, program managers can manage the end-to-end lifecycle of a program where they derive forecasts based on their customers’ forecasts, transform these forecasts into business opportunities, and convert those opportunities into run-rate business. Program based business is common across multiple industries such as process, aerospace, defense, automotive, engineer-to-order, and make-to-order environments.
description: See Learn About Program Based Business in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: IndustriesMfgRebates
summary: Enables Rebate Management. Manage incentive programs, track rebate attainment, automate payouts, and gain insights into sales performance and program effectiveness.
description: See Rebate Management in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: IndustriesMfgTargets
summary: Enables Sales Agreements. With Sales Agreements, you can negotiate purchase and sale of products over a continued period. You can also get insights into products, prices, discounts, and quantities. And you can track your planned and actual quantities and revenues with real-time updates from orders and contracts.
description: See Track Sales Compliance with Sales Agreements in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: IndustriesManufacturingCmty

description: See Improve Partner Collaboration with Communities in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: IndustriesMfgAccountForecast
summary: Enables Account Forecast. With Account Forecast, you can generate forecasts for your accounts based on orders, opportunities, and sales agreements. You can also create formulas to calculate your forecasts per the requirements of your company.
description: See Create Account Forecasts to Enhance Your Planning in Salesforce Help for more information.

description: Also requires Metadata API Settings in the scratch org definition file.

description: See Salesforce Knowledge in Salesforce Help for more information.

description: Requires configuration in the Setup menu of the scratch org.See Process Builder in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: ProductsAndSchedules
summary: Enables product schedules in your scratch org. Enabling this feature lets you create default product schedules on products. Users can also create schedules for individual products on opportunities.

name: ProductCatalogManagementAddOn
summary: Enables read-write access to Product Catalog Management features and objects.
description: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions. Provides 1 Product Catalog Management add-on license.

name: ProductCatalogManagementViewerAddOn
summary: Enables read access to Product Catalog Management features and objects.
description: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions. Provides 1 Product Catalog Management Viewer add-on license.

name: ProductCatalogManagementPCAddOn
summary: Enables read access to Product Catalog Management features and objects for Partner Community Users in scratch orgs.

name: ProgramManagement
summary: Enables access to all Program Management and Case Management features and objects.
description: To enable ProgramManagement, add these settings to your scratch org definition file.Alternatively, enable the settings in the org manually. See Enable Program Management in Salesforce Help.

name: ProviderFreePlatformCache
summary: Provides 3 MB of free Platform Cache capacity for security-reviewed managed packages. This feature is made available through a capacity type called Provider Free capacity and is automatically enabled in Developer Edition orgs. Allocate the Provider Free capacity to a Platform Cache partition and add it to your managed package.
description: See Set Up a Platform Cache Partition with Provider Free Capacity in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: ProviderManagement
summary: Enables the objects, features, and permissions for managing provider networks, care plans, and service delivery in Public Sector Solutions.
description: To enable ProviderManagement, add these features and settings to your scratch org definition file.

name: PSSAssetManagement
summary: Enables the objects, features, and permissions for managing assets in Public Sector Solutions.
description: To enable PSSAssetManagement, add these features and settings to your scratch org definition file.

name: PublicSectorAccess
summary: Enables access to all Public Sector features and objects.

name: PublicSectorApplicationUsageCreditsAddOn
summary: Enables additional usage of Public Sector applications based on their pricing.

name: PublicSectorSiteTemplate
summary: Allows Public Sector users access to build an Experience Cloud site from the templates available.

name: RateManagement
summary: Enables Rate Management that allows you to set, manage, and optimize rates for usage-based products.
description: See Configure Rate Pricing Calculations in Revenue Cloud in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: RecordTypes
summary: Enables Record Type functionality. Record Types let you offer different business processes, picklist values, and page layouts to different users.

name: RefreshOnInvalidSession
summary: Enables automatic refreshes of Lightning pages when the user's session is invalid. If, however, the page detects a new token, it tries to set that token and continue without a refresh.

name: RevSubscriptionManagement
summary: Enables Subscription Management. Subscription Management is an API-first, product-to-cash solution for B2B subscriptions and one-time sales.
description: Available in Enterprise and Developer scratch orgs. To enable Subscription Management in your scratch org, add this setting in your scratch org definition file.For more information about Subscription Management, see https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/revenue/subscription-management/overview.

name: S1ClientComponentCacheSize
summary: Allows the org to have up to 5 pages of caching for Lightning Components.

name: SalesCloudEinstein
summary: Enables Sales Cloud Einstein features and Salesforce Inbox. Sales Cloud Einstein brings AI to every step of the sales process.
description: Available in Enterprise Edition scratch orgs.See Sales Cloud Einstein in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: SalesforceContentUser
summary: Enables access to Salesforce content features.

name: SalesforceFeedbackManagementStarter
summary: Provides a license to use the Salesforce Feedback Management - Starter features.
description: Available in Enterprise and Developer edition scratch orgs. To use the Salesforce Feedback Management - Starter features, enable Surveys and assign the Salesforce Advanced Features Starter user permission to the scratch org user. For additional information on how to enable Surveys and configuration steps, see Enable Surveys and Configure Survey Settings and Assign User Permissions in Salesforce Help.

name: SalesforceHostedMCP
summary: Enables hosted MCP servers on the scratch org. With this scratch org feature parameter, MCP clients can connect to available hosted MCP servers.
description: Use of Salesforce hosted MCP servers requires setup of external clients. See Salesforce Hosted MCP Severs in Salesforce Help.

name: SalesforceIdentityForCommunities
summary: Adds Salesforce Identity components, including login and self-registration, to Experience Builder. This feature is required for Aura components.

name: SalesforcePricing
summary: Enables Salesforce Pricing, which allows you to set, manage, and optimize prices across your entire product portfolio
description: Provides 5 Salesforce Pricing Design Time AddOn, 5 Salesforce Pricing Run Time AddOn licenses. For more information, see Salesforce Pricing in Salesforce Help.

name: SalesUser
summary: Provides a license for Sales Cloud features.

name: SAML20SingleLogout
summary: Enables usage of SAML 2.0 single logout.

name: SCIMProtocol
summary: Enables access support for the SCIM protocol base API.

name: ScvMultipartyAndConsult
summary: Enables you to set up and test multiparty calls and consult calls for Service Cloud Voice with Partner Telephony.
description: This feature requires that you also include the ServiceCloudVoicePartnerTelephony scratch org feature in your scratch org definition file. Available in Salesforce Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer Editions.For setup and configuration steps, see Manage Multiparty Calls and Consult Calls in the Service Cloud Voice for Partner Telephony Developer Guide.

name: SecurityEventEnabled
summary: Enables access to security events in Event Monitoring.

name: SentimentInsightsFeature
summary: Provides the license required to enable and use Sentiment Insights in a scratch org. Use Sentiment Insights to analyze the sentiment of your customers and get actionable insights to improve it.
description: To use this scratch org feature, the Dev Hub org requires the IESentimentAnalysis, AwsSentimentAnalysis, BYOAForSentiment, and IESentimentAnalysisEnabled permissions. For information about Sentiment Insights, see Sentiment Insights in Salesforce Help.

name: ServiceCatalog
summary: Enables Employee Service Catalog so you can create a catalog of products and services for your employees. It can also turn your employees' requests for these products and services into approved and documented orders.
description: To use this scratch org feature, the Dev Hub org requires the ServiceCatalog permission. To learn more, see Employee Service Catalog.

name: ServiceCloud
summary: Assigns the Service Cloud license to your scratch org, so you can choose how your customers can reach you, such as by email, phone, social media, online communities, chat, and text.

name: ServiceCloudVoicePartnerTelephony
summary: Assigns the Service Cloud Voice with Partner Telephony add-on license to your scratch org, so you can set up a Service Cloud Voice contact center that integrates with supported telephony providers. Indicate a value from 1–50.
description: 1–50, Multiplier: 1For setup and configuration steps, see Service Cloud Voice with Partner Telephony in Salesforce Help.

name: ServiceUser
summary: Adds one Service Cloud User license, and allows access to Service Cloud features.

name: SessionIdInLogEnabled
summary: Enables Apex debug logs to include session IDs. If disabled, session IDs are replaced with "SESSION_ID_REMOVED" in debug logs.

name: SFDOInsightsDataIntegrityUser
summary: Provides a license to Salesforce.org Insights Platform Data Integrity managed package. You can then install the package in the scratch org.
description: For installation and configuration steps, see the Salesforce.org Insights Platform Data Integrity help.

name: SharedActivities
summary: Allow users to relate multiple contacts to tasks and events.
description: For additional installation and configuration steps, see Considerations for Enabling Shared Activities in Salesforce Help.

name: Sites
summary: Enables Salesforce Sites, which allows you to create public websites and applications that are directly integrated with your Salesforce org. Users aren’t required to log in with a username and password.
description: You can create sites and communities in a scratch org, but custom domains, such as www.example.com, aren't supported.

name: SocialCustomerService
summary: Enables Social Customer Service, sets post defaults, and either activates the Starter Pack or signs into your Social Studio account.

name: StateAndCountryPicklist
summary: Enables state and country/territory picklists. State and country/territory picklists let users select states and countries from predefined, standardized lists, instead of entering state, country, and territory data into text fields.

name: StreamingAPI
summary: Enables Streaming API.
description: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

name: StreamingEventsPerDay:<value>
summary: Increases the maximum number of delivered PushTopic event notifications within a 24-hour period, shared by all CometD clients (API version 36.0 and earlier). Indicate a value between 10,000–50,000.

name: SubPerStreamingChannel:<value>
summary: Increases the maximum number of concurrent clients (subscribers) per generic streaming channel (API version 36.0 and earlier). Indicate a value between 20–4,000.
description: 20–4,000, Multiplier: 1

name: SubPerStreamingTopic:<value>
summary: Increases the maximum number of concurrent clients (subscribers) per PushTopic streaming channel (API version 36.0 and earlier). Indicate a value between 20–4,000.
description: 20–4,000, Multiplier: 1

name: SurveyAdvancedFeatures
summary: Enables a license for the features available with the Salesforce Feedback Management - Growth license.
description: Available in Enterprise and Developer edition scratch orgs. To use the Salesforce Feedback Management - Growth features, enable Surveys and assign the Salesforce Surveys Advanced Features user permission to the scratch org user. For additional information on how to enable Surveys and configuration steps, see Enable Surveys and Configure Survey Settings and Assign User Permissions in Salesforce Help.

name: SustainabilityCloud
summary: Provides the permission set licenses and permission sets required to install and configure Sustainability Cloud. To enable or use CRM Analytics and CRM Analytics templates, include the DevelopmentWave scratch org feature.
description: For installation and configuration steps, see Sustainability Cloud Legacy Documentation in the Set Up and Maintain Net Zero Cloud guide in Salesforce Help.

name: SustainabilityApp
summary: Provides the permission set licenses and permission sets required to configure Net Zero Cloud. To enable or use Tableau CRM and Tableau CRM templates, include the DevelopmentWave scratch org feature.
description: Add these options to your scratch org definition file:For configuration steps, see Configure Net Zero Cloud in the Set Up and Maintain Net Zero Cloud guide in Salesforce Help.

name: TalentRecruitmentManagement
summary: Enables the objects, features, and permissions for managing the talent recruitment and hiring process in Public Sector Solutions.
description: To enable TalentRecruitmentManagement, add these features and settings to your scratch org definition file.

name: TCRMforSustainability
summary: Enables all permissions required to manage the Net Zero Analytics app by enabling Tableau CRM. You can create and share the analytics app for your users to bring your environmental accounting in line with your financial accounting.
description: For more information, see Deploy Net Zero Analytics in the Set Up and Maintain Net Zero Cloud guide in Salesforce Help.

name: TimelineConditionsLimit
summary: Limits the number of timeline record display conditions per event type to 3.
description: See Provide Holistic Patient Care with Enhanced Timeline in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: TimelineEventLimit
summary: Limits the number of event types displayed on a timeline to 5.
description: See Provide Holistic Patient Care with Enhanced Timeline in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: TimelineRecordTypeLimit
summary: Limits the number of related object record types per event type to 3.
description: See Provide Holistic Patient Care with Enhanced Timeline in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: TimeSheetTemplateSettings
summary: Time Sheet Templates let you configure settings to create time sheets automatically. For example, you can create a template that sets start and end dates. Assign templates to user profiles so that time sheets are created for the right users.
description: For configuration steps, see Create Time Sheet Templates in Salesforce Help.

name: TransactionFinalizers
summary: Enables you to implement and attach Apex Finalizers to Queueable Apex jobs.
description: This functionality is currently in open pilot and subject to restrictions.See the Transaction Finalizers (Pilot) in Apex Developer Guide for more information.

name: UsageManagement
summary: Enables Usage Management. Using Usage Management, you can setup, track, and manage the consumption of usage-based products.
description: See Usage Management in Salesforce Help for more information.

name: VolunteerManagement
summary: Gives users access to Volunteer Management features and objects in Salesforce.
description: See Nonprofit Cloud for Volunteer Management in Salesforce Help for more information. To enable Volunteer Management, add these settings to your scratch org definition file.Volunteer Management licenses are assigned when the Volunteer Management feature is enabled in the scratch org.

name: WaveMaxCurrency
summary: Increases the maximum number of supported currencies for CRM Analytics. Indicate a value between 1–5.

name: WavePlatform
summary: Enables the Wave Platform license.

name: Workflow
summary: Enables Workflow so you can automate standard internal procedures and processes.
description: Requires configuration in the Setup menu of the scratch org.

name: WorkflowFlowActionFeature
summary: Allows you to launch a flow from a workflow action.
description: This setting is supported only if you enabled the pilot program in your org for flow trigger workflow actions. If you enabled the pilot, you can continue to create and edit flow trigger workflow actions.If you didn't enable the pilot, use the Flows action in the ProcessBuilder scratch org feature instead.

name: WorkplaceCommandCenterUser
summary: Enables access to Workplace Command Center features including access to objects such as Employee, Crisis, and EmployeeCrisisAssessment.
description: For additional installation and configuration steps, see Set Up Your Work.com Development Org in the Workplace Command Center for Work.com Developer Guide.

name: WorkThanksPref
summary: Enables the give thanks feature in Chatter.
